;International relations
*[[2018 Brussels summit]]
**[[Accession of Macedonia to NATO]]
***[[NATO]] formally invites [[Republic of Macedonia|Macedonia]] to begin membership talks to join the organization. [https://www.rferl.org/a/nato-invites-macedonia-membership-talks/29357531.html (RFE/RL)]

;Law and crime
*[[National Socialist Underground trial]]
**In [[Germany]], the accused members and supporters of the [[Neo-Nazism|Neo-Nazi]] [[Terrorism|terrorist]] group [[National Socialist Underground]] are found guilty of the murders of nine [[immigrants]] and one policewoman, assistance in said murders, bomb attacks, attempted murders, and robbery. The main defendant and last surviving member of the terrorist group, [[Beate Zschäpe]], is sentenced to life imprisonment. [https://www.dw.com/en/neo-nazi-nsu-member-beate-zsch%C3%A4pe-found-guilty-of-murder-sentenced-to-life-in-prison/a-44626859 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Murder of XXXTentacion]]
**A second suspect is arrested in connection with the murder of rapper [[XXXTentacion]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/police-make-second-arrest-rapper-xxxtentacion-s-murder-n890536 (NBC News)]

**[[Croatia national football team|Croatia]] defeats [[England national football team|England]] 2–1 after extra time, advancing to their first-ever [[2018 FIFA World Cup Final|World Cup final]], which will be against [[France national football team|France]] on July 15.
